findings.text: The company was incorporated on 10 February 2004 and has 2 current directors, PERSON 320 (appointed 1 May 2006) and PERSON 321 (appointed 10 February 2004).
One insolvency case is on record, with the status 'in administration' and administration started on 12 December 2025.
Accounts are overdue; they were last made up to 30 December 2023 and the next accounts were due 30 December 2025.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 22 May 2025 and the next statement is due 5 June 2026.

Two persons with significant control are recorded: HOLDINGS LTD, and CANARY-A27 (individual; ownership of shares 25 to 50 percent, voting rights 25 to 50 percent, right to appoint and remove directors), with PERSON 327 (individual; significant influence or control) also listed.
Four charges are registered: 2 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 2 satisfied.
Across the 2 current directors, 11 other companies were found, of which 1 is in administration; these figures exclude the company being checked and may be incomplete.
One registered office address change was filed on 29 December 2025, and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
